label: One admissible profile has one favouring, good-general if it has good-generality
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: every admissible intrinsic profile q (a set of real determinations a simple, unreceived, necessary source could jointly have) is realized by one favouring profile psi: every favouring determination in q is the determination that the bearer's favouring is psi, and if q contains the good-generality determination, psi is good-general (for some scenario and candidates, at least one not a present input, it depends on betterness with end-realization held fixed, BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2). The 'one' is where simplicity enters: a composite source could have a fixed natural inclination and a good-general appetite as two powers, and then two favourings would be jointly admissible. It is a reading of the favouring tokens and of admissibility, not a theorem about them.
